summary: Backend + frontend smoke validation of Audit KNHOST Bagian III fixes (KN-E01/E02/E03/E04c/E12/E17/E23/E31/E37/E38/E39/E44/E45/E50). Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_audit_bagian_iii.py — 24 tests, 24 passed (0 failed, 0 skipped after fixes). Frontend smoke via public preview URL: admin login → Pesanan (?view=sales / Kasir & Portal), Kedatangan Barang (?view=goods-receipts), Tanya KN (?view=tanya-kn) all render side nav + main content with no page errors and 0 error elements; sales login (Ayu) renders /?view=sales POS OK. Every audited finding was reproduced and now behaves per audit spec.
action_items: OPTIONAL (out-of-scope of Bagian III): services/ai_number_check._SKIP_CTX month regex has no leading word-boundary — text like 'panjang 2050 m' masks 'jang 2050' because '(jan)[a-z]*' matches 'jang' inside 'panjang'. This can suppress a legitimate number check when the surrounding word happens to start with a month prefix. Consider prefixing _MONTHS alternatives with \b.
critical_code_review_comments: E01 fix in services/sales_ownership.py is clean and single-sourced (list + IDOR guard share owner_clause/assert_may_open); explicitly excludes name-based matching (id-only $or on created_by/sales_id/sales_team.sales_id).

E12 dn_rules.match_po now anchors PO tokens with (?<![A-Z0-9]) / (?![A-Z0-9]) after whitespace-stripped normalization — PO-1 no longer collides with PO-12 in isolated token contexts (verified). NOTE: because normalize() strips whitespace, the token guard only matches when the PO number is bordered by non-alnum chars in the raw text (dashes, quotes, EOL). Free text like 'PO-12 kirim' becomes 'PO-12KIRIM' → no match. If audit intended broader detection, evaluate keeping whitespace in norm.
E37 list_records collects `unused = filters - used` and raises AnalyticsError('Saringan … belum didukung') → HTTP 400 with clear message. Good.
E45 settings PUT rejects scope='integrations' (must go through /api/integrations) and scope='global' response does not leak api_key/openai fields — verified.

E04c amendments/{id}/decision second call returns 400 'sudah diputus'. Note there is also a self-approval guard ('pengusul tidak boleh menyetujui usulannya sendiri') which is a nice-to-have not in the audit scope.
